title: Bus to Town
design_goal: The metro-under-construction reveal; the bus as a social space; the first World-War-Z voices (a nurse, a headline).

cast.role: Double shift, Hebbal side, strange cases (nurse_heard) - reappears as the ward nurse in Act 3
Headline: HIVR visiting-institute study, third phase (uncle_headline)

beats.what: The metro station across the road: barricades, 'NAMMA METRO - OPENING SOON', hand-painted 'Use bus 500-D'. Reading the sign sets metro_seen.
The 500-D arrives every 90 s (HUD countdown, the bus pulls in and stands 20 s). Board from the kerb stop: ₹35 (UPI).
beats.interact: walk onto the stop while the bus stands

beats.what: The bus interior, a 25-second ride that pauses while you talk: the nurse (Hebbal, strange cases), the uncle (HIVR headline), the sleeping kid.

assets_needed: street_props sheet (bus, barricade, pillar, auto, van)
sheets: nurse, bus uncle, bus kid
acceptance: the barricade's sign sets metro_seen and the quest's first step
the 500-D stop refuses boarding until the bus stands there; the HUD counts down to it; boarding costs ₹35
the bus interior lasts 25 s of free play, holds while a passenger talks, and ends at Cubbon Park on its own
arriving sets cubbon_arrived and completes the quest; Cubbon Park's own quest starts on arrival
